next.reason: 1985: 'The NO REWIND phrase must only be used with: a. Sequential single reel/unit files. ... b. Sequential files wholly contained within a single reel'; 2023: 'The NO REWIND phrase may be specified only for sequential files.'. 1985 limits NO REWIND to single-reel/unit sequential files. 2023 allows any sequential file, including multi-unit ones, and ignores the phrase where the medium does not apply (status '07').
